description: This file is an assembly source file for ARM initialization, including setting up core modes, exception vectors, stack pointers, and memory control registers. It contains startup code for an embedded system based on ARM architecture, specifically for the AT91RM9200 series.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Entry point of the startup assembly code, setting up stack pointers for different CPU modes and branching to main.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for program execution, called after system initialization.
